scenes.title: The sound alone: drops fall with no food
scenes.era: Early 1900s, Physiology Department, Imperial Institute of Experimental Medicine, St. Petersburg (earliest period, experimenter still in the room counting drops)
scenes.space: Bright laboratory room with tall windows. A low wooden stand (table) in the middle; above it a wooden frame with an overhead crossbar from which leather straps hold the dog's harness. The dog stands side-on to camera, head toward a wooden shelf on which the metronome ticks. An assistant sits on a stool close to the dog's cheek with a notebook; a graduated glass tube is clamped to a small stand beside the dog's head, fed by a thin tube from the cheek funnel. No food bowl anywhere in view.
scenes.lighting: Bright daylight from tall laboratory windows, clean and photoreal.
scenes.wardrobe: Pavlov: white laboratory coat, full white beard (portrait photographs; actor in M2 recreation). Assistant: white laboratory coat, dark trousers. Dog: matte-white porcelain dog, brown leather harness keeps its real colour.

props.behaviour: a clear bead of saliva swells at its spout and drips

props.name: graduated glass tube / cylinder

beats.action: flicks the metronome pendulum -> sits back -> leans toward the cheek funnel -> counts drops with pencil taps -> scribbles tally marks
ears prick at the ticking -> licks its lips -> shifts weight forward in the harness while saliva drips from the cheek funnel
pencil freezes mid-tally, shoulders lift, leans closer to the tube
grips the edge of the stand and bends in, hands on knees

scenes.recognition_hook: A harnessed dog drooling into a glass tube at the sound of a ticking metronome, with no food in sight - 'Pavlov's dog'.

key_visual.description: the harnessed porcelain dog hears the ticking metronome before any food appears and saliva drips from the cheek tube into the graduated glass vial

scenes.title: Timing test: buzzer after food vs before food

scenes.space: Same stand; an electric buzzer box mounted on the wall with a push button on a cord held by the assistant. Split staging: first the bowl then the buzz (nothing in the tube), then the buzz then the bowl (tube fills).

scenes.title: The soundproof laboratory: dog alone, experimenter behind the wall
scenes.era: 1910s, special laboratory at the Institute of Experimental Medicine (exact completion year not verified)
scenes.space: One research room split in two by a thick soundproof partition. Left compartment: the dog alone on its stand with funnel and tube. Right compartment: the experimenter at a small control board, squeezing a rubber bulb (pneumatic transmission) or pressing a switch that starts the stimulus, reading drops on a recorder. Blocking echo of M1 operator-at-panel frame.
